reddit.title: Improved Music Transitions in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant enhancements to the music system in Provincia! No more awkward transitions between day, night, title, and combat beds. Our new long equal-power self-crossfade ensures a seamless listening experience. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops

steam.title: Enhanced Music System in Provincia
steam.body: We're excited to announce improvements to the music transitions in Provincia! The awkward cuts between different audio beds are now replaced with a long equal-power crossfade, providing a more immersive experience. Read more about the changes in our latest devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
